heading: Beyond modern masters: Indian art is being reshaped by confident domestic buyers as auction market triples
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: From  ₹700 crore in 2020 to more than  ₹2,400 crore in 2025, India's art auction market has tripled, widening its buyer demographics. Increased access to information has empowered collectors, while emerging private museums support a vibrant, growing ecosystem of artists and cultural institutions.
